headline: Philippine PSEi Index Rebounds to Snap Four-Day Slump
summary: The Philippine Stock Exchange index (PSEi) rebounded on Tuesday, ending four consecutive sessions of losses as investors engaged in bargain hunting.
why: The PSEi is the principal benchmark index for equities traded on the Philippine Stock Exchange.

impacts.name: PSEi Index
impacts.why: Bargain-hunting buyers drove the benchmark index higher after four days of declines.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors stepped in to buy oversold shares following four consecutive days of index declines.
